name: Shimaizuma
source:
Misako is a widow who lost her husband at a young age. She works as a teacher at school. She and college second grader girl Miki get drowned into a whirlpool of lust by three men.
A multi-site adventure from the point of view of Misako, Miki and one of the males.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
美沙子年纪轻轻便丧夫，如今在学校担任教师。她与大学二年级学生美树一同被三个男人卷入欲望的漩涡。
游戏采用多视角叙事，分别从美沙子、美树及其中一名男子的视角展开。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
